body.summary: Current PLAN4 tasks T1–T5 have passed their gates; T6 adds operation-bound application integrity, captured file reads, external publisher runtime use and a release-owned Windows exclusion. All 26 surrounding cases passed; the gate-only fixture closure-mode failure was corrected and the 11 publisher cases then passed without inherited coordinator flags. T7–T10, the heavy full-payload regression and fresh macOS/Linux VM qualification remain pending; historical later-task rows do not establish completion and final Story BUILD has not been approved.
